item.title: Israeli strikes kill Iran Guards intel chief as Trump deadline looms
item.summary: Israeli strikes killed the intelligence chief of Iran's Revolutionary Guards, as the Islamic republic on Monday defied threats from US President Donald Trump to devastate civilian infrastructure if it does not reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: War in the Middle East: At least four killed in strike on Haifa
item.summary: Iranian missiles hit the northern Israeli city of Haifa, where four people were found dead in the rubble of a residential building.

item.title: War in the Middle East: 15 dead in Israeli strikes on Lebanon
item.summary: An Israeli strike on south Beirut killed at least 15 people and wounded 39 on Sunday.

item.title: US president Donald Trump warns Tehran to reopen Hormuz or face "hell"
item.summary: Iran and the United States received a draft proposal late Sunday calling for a 45-day ceasefire and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.
